title: GovDash Integrates with Google Drive
summary: GovDash now integrates with Google Drive. Bring documents from approved Drive locations into GovDash anywhere you attach files, from the Data Library and solicitation packages to proposal drafts, contracts, and teaming agreements.
body_markdown:
GovDash now integrates with Google Drive. Bring documents from approved Drive locations into GovDash anywhere you attach files, from the Data Library and solicitation packages to proposal drafts, contracts, and teaming agreements.


### Less file wrangling, more time to win


- **Start pursuits with everything in place.** Bring capture notes, teaming agreements, and past performance into an opportunity the moment you decide to pursue it.


- **Build proposals from your real record.** Pull resumes and past performance write-ups from Drive at kickoff, so your team works from the evidence it already has.


- **Keep your folders the way you built them.** No migration and no restructuring. Your team keeps working in Drive.


- **Give security the controls it expects.** Admins approve the folders, shared drives, or files your team can import from, and each user sees only what their Google account can already open. GovDash has read-only access and never edits, moves, or deletes anything in Drive.


### Connect once, upload anywhere


1. Each teammate connects their own Google account, from Settings > Integrations or straight from the Google Drive tab in any upload window.


2. A team admin approves the folders, shared drives, or files the team can import from.


3. Anywhere you attach documents, open the Google Drive tab, select your files, and confirm.


GovDash imports a snapshot of each file, so later edits in Drive won't change the copy in GovDash. Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides come in as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.


Every file gets a data classification as you import it, CUI or non-CUI, and GovDash protects it according to that classification from then on. Because GovDash only reads from Drive, you can connect whether or not your Google Workspace is configured for CUI.[See how GovDash protects CUI](https://www.govdash.com/security)


### One platform, connected to the tools you already use


Google Drive joins a growing set of integrations that put GovDash at the center of your GovCon business.


#### Opportunity sources


Discover brings opportunities from SAM.gov, GSA eBuy, GovWin, PIEE, and SLED portals in all 50 states into one pipeline, so your team spends less time searching and more time qualifying.


#### Workflow integrations


SharePoint, Google Drive, Salesforce, Okta SSO, Google SSO, and webhooks connect GovDash to the systems your business already runs on.


#### Dash in your apps


Dash works inside Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Slack, and Microsoft Teams, plus a browser extension, so your team gets help where it already works.


#### Connectors for Dash


Connectors let Dash reference context from Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook, HubSpot, Gong, Confluence, Jira, and more. That includes Google Drive: Dash can search and reference your Drive files in a conversation, and the new upload integration brings those documents into GovDash itself, next to your opportunities, proposals, and contracts.


**See every integration GovDash supports —>**[Explore integrations](https://www.govdash.com/integrations)


### Get started


Admins can connect Google Drive from Settings > Configurations > Connected Services, under the Integrations tab.


**Set up Google Drive for your team —>**[Read the Google Drive setup guide](https://support.govdash.com/docs/google-drive-integration-setup)


**See GovDash working with your own files —>** Walk through Google Drive, Dash, and the full platform with our team on a live workspace.[Book a demo](https://www.govdash.com/book-a-demo)
